senses.gloss:
ITA-3.13.1 asthi अस्थि
Bone

ITA-5.3.19 asthikṣayaḥ अस्थिक्षयः
Diminution of bone
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: scalp hair loss/thinning; body hair loss/ thinning; nail fall/thinning; beard/moustache loss/thinning; tooth loss/decay; exhaustion/fatigue; joint dislocation/laxity; bone pains; cracked teeth; cracked nails; dryness; roughness/ dryness; pricking type of bone pains; desire to eat bony meat.

ITA-3.13.2 asthikhaṇḍaḥ अस्थिखण्डः
Part of bone

ITA-5.73.8 asthigata-śalyaḥ अस्थिगत-शल्यः
Foreign body in the bones
A disorder due to presence of foreign body in the bones; characterized by a feeling of fullness; various types of pain; oedema.

ITA-5.61.19 asthigatamasūrikā अस्थिगतमसूरिका
Lentil-shaped pox disease localized in bone
Lentil-shaped eruptive disorder is characterized by eruptions which are small in size; colour of eruptions similar to skin; dry eruptions; flat eruptions; slightly raised eruptions; marked confusion; pain; severe distress/discontent/restlessness; damaging the vital parts or marmasthāna; causing sudden death; pain in bones as if stung by bee.

ITA-5.2.1.19 asthigatavātaḥ अस्थिगतवातः
Aggravation of vata in bone
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: cracking type of pain in bone and small joints; extreme wasting of muscles/diminution of muscle mass; loss of physical strength or weakness; insomnia/sleeplessness; constant pain; pain in thighs; pain in joints; severe loss of physical strength; diminution of asthi/osteopenia/ osteoporosis.

ITA-3.13.70 asthijālam अस्थिजालम्
Network of bones

ITA-2.2.10 asthi-dhātuḥ अस्थिधातुः
Bone
The fifth of the seven fundamental structural components. Its function is to provide bodily stability. It is composed predominantly of the basic elements earth and space. It refers to bone tissue.

ITA-5.6.32 asthidhātugatajvaraḥ अस्थिधातुगतज्वरः
Fever due to vitiated bone
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: purgation and emesis; breaking/splitting type of bone pains; cooing like a pigeon; convulsive movements of limbs; breathlessness/difficulty in breathing; purging; vomiting; upward and downward expulsion of dosha.

ITA-2.6.16 asthidhātvagniḥ अस्थिधात्वग्निः
Metabolic factors located in bone
The transformative factor which converts fat to bone

ITA-2.2.14 asthipañjaraḥ अस्थिपञ्जरः
Skeleton
The bony framework of the body.

ITA-3.16.15 asthimarma अस्थिमर्म
Vulnerable location(s) in which the main structural component is bone
Marma where bone/skeletal tissue is structurally prominent. .

ITA-2.5.15 asthivahasrotaḥ अस्थिवहस्रोतः
Channel carrying bone
The pathway for bone. Entities related to this channel are fat and the hip region.

ITA-5.5.9 asthivahasrotoduṣṭiḥ अस्थिवहस्रोतोदुष्टिः
Vitiation of channels carrying bone
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: hypertrophy of bones and teeth or atrophy, pain in the teeth, bones discoloration of the hair, head, body, face, and nails.

ITA-5.73.31 asthivahasrotoviddhaḥ अस्थिवहस्रोतोविद्धः
Injury to the channels that nourish bone

ITA-2.2.15 asthivivaram अस्थिविवरम्
Medullary canal
The cavity within the bone containing marrow.

ITA-5.3.20 asthivṛddhiḥ अस्थिवृद्धिः
Morbid increase of bone
A disorder characterized by excessive growth of bones/ overlapping bones; excessive growth of teeth/redundant overlapping teeth.

ITA-5.3.18 asthivaiṣamyam अस्थिवैषम्यम्
Disproportion of bone
Changes in the normal quantity and quality of osseous tissue.

ITA-3.13.64 asthisaṅghātaḥ, saṅghātaḥ अस्थिसङ्घातः, सङ्घातः
Conglomeration of bones
A site at which more than two bones articulate or come together.

ITA-2.2.13 parva, asthisandhayaḥ, asthiparva पर्व, अस्थिसन्धयः, अस्थिपर्व
Articulation, joint
The junction or interface between two bones comprising bone and connective tissue.

ITA-2.8.1.6 asthi-sāraḥ अस्थिसारः
Person with predominance or essence of bone
Characterized by features such as having large heels, ankles, knees, forearms, clavicles, chin, head, joints, bones, nails, teeth; having great enthusiasm; dynamism; ability to tolerate suffering; having firmness of body and longevity.

ITA-3.2.1.38 asthyāśritaṃpaṭalam अस्थ्याश्रितंपटलम्
Nuclear part of lens
The fourth layer of the eye.

ITA-9.2.75 āsthāpanabastiḥ/ nirūhabastiḥ आस्थापनबस्तिः/ निरूहबस्तिः
Therapeutic decoction enema
The therapeutic procedure of administering a medication predominantly by means of a decoction enema.
